steps.content: In the final snowstorm that sweeps across Northwild, Jichuan walks alone to the farthest end she can reach. Sustained only by the last remnants of life the shackles can give, she goes to a place where her passing burdens no one.
//Fade in from black to cave
The cave's damp chill seeps through her clothes and intertwines with the suffocating pain churning in her chest. Like a spider's web, it binds Jichuan's life to this moment, to this place.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: So this is what death feels like...

Outside the cave, the wind's wailing blurs into a distant hum. Her vision grows hazy. It feels as though the whole world narrows to nothing but her faint breathing, a flickering flame on the edge of going out.
Her life force ebbs with every breath. Her limbs become heavier and heavier. The pain in her body begins to fade, as if gentle hands cradle her, carrying her somewhere deeper and quieter.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: This is as far as I go, huh...
Her voice is barely a whisper, heavy with exhaustion finally released, each word growing fainter and slower than the last...
//Black screen blink effect
//BG: Ancient Chinese-style interior

Jichuan stirs awake in a surge of warmth. An unfamiliar yet reassuring power moves through her limbs and chest... The last time she felt this vital, this alive, was in her childhood—before Mania claimed her and she fell terminally ill.
She blinks her eyes open. What meets her gaze is no longer the cold cave but warm, traditional furnishings.
Sunlight streams through the windows, and nearby, the soft bubble of boiling tea water fills the quiet.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Is this... a dream?
She reaches out, attempting to grasp the sunlight before her, when she suddenly realizes her body feels lighter than it ever has before.

steps.speaker: Familiar Voice
steps.content: Chuan'er? You're awake.
A gentle push swings the door open, and a familiar voice drifts in on a warm breeze.
Jichuan props herself up in disbelief, unable to look away from the person now entering the room.

steps.speaker: Familiar Voice
steps.content: What's with that look? Still dreaming, are you? I made pumpkin porridge. You said you wanted some yesterday. Come, try it while it's warm.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: ...Mother...?
To Jichuan, the word feels so foreign that it leaves her throat hoarse the moment she speaks it. She rubs her eyes.

The woman in front of her looks down, her gaze settling on Jichuan's face with a soft, tender warmth. A slight smile touches her lips, and the delicate crow's feet at the corners of her eyes mirror Jichuan's memory exactly, down to the smallest detail.

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Mother
steps.content: Oh my, how did your voice get so hoarse from just sleep?
As if sensing Jichuan's unease, the woman sits down on the edge of the bed. She takes Jichuan's hand and cradles it inside her warm palms.

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Mother
steps.content: Your hands are so cold. A bad dream? Tell me, what did you dream about?
Jichuan seems unused to the warmth of being held. She watches those hands gently rubbing hers to chase away the cold, and tears spill from her eyes without her ever feeling them start.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I... I dreamed so many things. I dreamed the snow at the manor fell heavier and heavier, burying everything. I dreamed... that I tried with everything I could to make it stop...

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: That you and Father, my friends, and everything I believed in and fought to protect all faded away into that endless white.

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Mother
steps.content: Silly child, it's spring now. It's all right... Everything will be all right.

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Mother
steps.content: If you're cold, just put on more clothes. I'll have your father prepare some pickled ginger later. You can have it with the pumpkin porridge. That'll warm you up.
Her mother wraps Jichuan in her arms and gives her back a gentle pat, just like she did back when Jichuan was small.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Father is here too?

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Mother
steps.content: Silly girl, still foggy from sleep, aren't you? This is our home. Where else would your father be?

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Home...?
//Sound effect of door opening

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Father
steps.content: "You two little ones better grow up healthy and strong. Don't let all my hard work go to waste..."

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Mother
steps.content: Listen to your silly father, talking to those seedlings again. Can you believe it? A master herbalist who can't even keep two little vegetables alive...

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Father
steps.content: Badmouthing me to Chuan'er again, are you? Let me tell you, these are specially cultivated varieties. They grow slowly, but they're full of nutrition!
Straightening up in the courtyard, the figure turns toward Jichuan, his face illuminated by that same warm, gentle smile.

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Mother
steps.content: Perfect, then. We'll use your most nutritious little seedlings to nourish Chuan'er and settle her nerves.

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Father
steps.content: What's this? Something scared my Chuan'er? Tell me who it was, and I'll give them a proper talking-to!
As he speaks, he rolls up his sleeves, revealing the thin, scholarly arms beneath. Jichuan can't help but laugh.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: And this talking-to of yours, Father... will it be an hour long, or two?
Seen right through by his daughter, her father takes it in stride with good humor, scratching his head sheepishly before turning his attention back to those pitifully small seedlings.
Seeing Jichuan's smile again, her mother finally eases. She turns toward the earthen stove in the corner.

A vegetable garden, a thatched cottage, a home... Bamboo medicine baskets scattered across the courtyard give off the fragrance of various herbs, blending with warm spring sunlight and the comforting scent of everyday life. Jichuan has never truly lived this way, but she knows exactly what this is...

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>When I was little, my parents told me that once the snow at Northsnow Manor stopped falling, once the people below the mountain no longer suffered... we would go together to a place no one knew... tend a garden, water the flowers, and live a life free from the world's troubles.</color><i>

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>How could I ever forget... This was my parents' dearest wish while they were still alive...</color><i>

Dazed, Jichuan sits down by the stone table as her mother presses a bowl of hot porridge into her hands. The bottom of the bowl scalds her, but she doesn't feel it until the heat shocks her back into awareness.

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Mother
steps.content: Oh dear, my fault! I should have warned you it was hot. Did you burn yourself? Shall I get some ointment... Chuan'er? Chuan'er?

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Mother
steps.content: Oh... you're crying again? That's twice this morning already.

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Father
steps.content: "Snow melts from icy peaks, first turning into jade. The river, fed by clearing skies, begins to flow with spring." Chuan means river, and a river is made of water. Let her cry a thousand times if she wishes.
Helplessly, Jichuan wipes her face, then glances at her fingertips, now red from the burn.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I'm fine. I just... I don't know what's come over me. Everything feels like a dream, and yet the warmth, the pain... they're far too real...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I should be in that freezing cave, quietly slipping away from this world. By now, I should have already—
Chuan!

The voice reaches her before its owner does. Then a small figure bursts into the courtyard from outside, carrying a bamboo pole. The instant she recognizes who it is, the bowl of porridge nearly slips from her hands.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: By now, I should have already died.
The figure fails to catch her whispered words. She lifts her head, innocent smile in place, tilting it as her gaze meets Jichuan's.

steps.speaker: Mudling
steps.content: What are you muttering about? Is it a new plan for us to roam the world together?

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Mudling... Why are you here too?
Her face is so close, vivid and real. Jichuan reaches out, wipes the dirt from her cheeks, and she feels it again: the warmth of living skin under her fingers.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I see now... Of course you'd be here. Whether this is a dream or reality no longer matters.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>I understand now. This is a place where the departed reunite. And the departed... include myself.</color><i>
She lowers her head to drink the porridge, using the motion to hide the tears welling in her eyes. The warm porridge slides down her throat and flows gently through her.
She takes another spoonful, then another. It settles in her stomach, and as it fills her, warmth spreads through her chest too.
Mudling sits beside her and takes a bowl of hot porridge from her mother's hands, slurping it eagerly.

The four of them gather around the stone table in quiet contentment. Her parents chat about daily clinic matters while Mudling chimes in enthusiastically—not quite grasping everything, but eager to join in.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Your straightforward words seem to shatter the invisible wall between you. After a moment of silence, Dove steps aside, opening the door to her room.

Jichuan cradles the warm bowl in her hands, lost in thought, gazing at her dear family and friend around her—all of them long dead. Then she suddenly recalls the old folktales she once read about the world beyond.
The wicked meet their end and descend into darkness; the virtuous depart and reunite with loved ones beyond...
Her heart settles. She blows away the rising steam, tips the bowl back, and downs the last of the pumpkin porridge in a single, final gulp.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Mudling, now that you've finished eating, time for practice!

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Father, I'll help you in the fields once we're done training.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Mother, can we have rice cakes for lunch?

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Mother
steps.content: Would you like some dried fruit in them?

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Yes!
She grows accustomed to this vibrant body, embracing the garden blooming with life around her. Her voice turns brighter, each word ringing with newfound clarity.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Mudling, I met quite a few martial masters in my dreams last night and learned a new sword technique that can break formations. Care to try it out with me?

steps.speaker: Mudling
steps.content: I can't believe you've been sneaking in extra training behind my back! I've been getting stronger too, y'know. No way I'm falling behind! Check this out!

The two of them tumble across the courtyard in a playful brawl, caring little for proper form. Her parents shake their heads helplessly, letting them roughhouse from the eaves all the way up to the rooftop.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: This move is called <color=#fb9259>Shadows Aslant</color>!

steps.speaker: Mudling
steps.content: Then try my <color=#fb9259>Sea Dragon's Ascent</color>!

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I'll counter it with my own <color=#fb9259>Snowdrift Blitz</color>!

steps.speaker: Mudling
steps.content: Hah! You let your guard down! My Beggar Staff Technique's unbeatable!
Jichuan draws the plum branch staff, Bent Jade, from her side and swings. Mudling snatches a bamboo pole to parry. Their banter stays playful, but genuine technique flows through every move.
The bamboo pole grazes Jichuan's cheek. She bends backward to dodge, tilts her head up, and glimpses something white falling from the clear sky.
A single snowflake drifts down, landing on the red mole between her brows.

steps.speaker: Mudling
steps.content: Huh? That's weird. Spring's already here, isn't it?
Mudling stops as well, leaning closer to see. But the snowflake melts at once from the warmth of Jichuan's skin, disappearing without a trace. Overhead, the clear sky shows no sign of change.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Perhaps... we were just seeing things.

Jichuan offers reassurance, yet her expression grows distant. In that brief moment of contact with the snowflake, she feels her heart skip a beat. Something from the depths of her consciousness—some connection—stirs within her.
For reasons she cannot name, someone comes to mind... A name buried deep in her heart, from a distant, foreign land...
//BG: Chief's Office, DisCity MBCC

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, a new report just came in from Eastia.
Several days have passed since your return from Eastia, yet that bitter snowstorm refuses to let you go.
You have thrown every resource at your disposal, reaching out to every Eastian faction you can find, all for one purpose: a single trace of Jichuan.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This time... nothing again?
One look at Nightingale's expression, and you already know the answer.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thanks. Just leave it there.

Reports on Jichuan's whereabouts pile into a small mountain on your desk. You pore over each one, attempting to feel every faint lead through the shackles... Day after day, you turn up nothing. Nightingale watches you in your exhausted state, her lips parting, but she thinks better of it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know what you're thinking. All signs point to the possibility that Jichuan might not be alive. Don't worry, I'm not blind to it. Eastia's just as concerned about the situation in Northwild; they won't just let her disappearance go unanswered either.
You rise from your seat and walk to the window, your gaze settling on the withered plum branch in the white porcelain vase. That branch is the only trace of her you managed to bring back from Eastia.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I trust what the shackles are telling me... Jichuan is alive.
The withered branch offers no answers to your hopes. You let out a sigh and reach for the porcelain vase, readying yourself to change its water.
But just as your fingertips brush the vase, you see it: at the very tip of the branch turned toward the sun, a tender green bud, no bigger than a thought, begins to push through.
//Sound effect of communicator
Just then, your terminal emits an urgent chime.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief... this is from Eastia. They found Jichuan!
